# Vendor parts

Datasheets, drawings and CAD for every off-the-shelf part, one folder per part. Each folder's
README gives the source URLs, retrieval date and the dimensions the design relies on.

| Part | Folder | Used for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| RobStride 02 | `robstride-02/` | hip pitch, knee |
| Damiao DM-J4310P-2EC (48 V) | `damiao-dm-j4310p-2ec/` | hip ab/ad, neck |
